name: No Mice in Heaven
source:
A short drama/suspense kinetic novel about mediocrity, jealousy, obsession, salvation, postgraduate animal research, and how they affect the relationships surrounding a girl named April. Let it be known that lab conditions must remain sterile.

[From [url=https://23noko.itch.io/no-mice-in-heaven]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一部短篇戏剧/悬疑动态小说，讲述平庸、嫉妒、痴迷、救赎、研究生动物研究，以及它们如何影响围绕一个名叫阿普丽尔的女孩的关系。让我们知道实验室条件必须保持无菌。

[来自[url=https://23noko.itch.io/no-mice-in-heaven]itch.io[/url]]
